article_context: 第一人称回顾升学前的职业探索：从服装设计转向新闻写作，再寻找能把时尚与写作结合起来的课程，最终发现 Fashion Media & Promotion。

article.title: 翻译 · 在时尚与写作之间找到自己的方向
article.background: 第一人称回顾升学前的职业探索：从服装设计转向新闻写作，再寻找能把时尚与写作结合起来的课程，最终发现 Fashion Media & Promotion。

sentences.en: My dream has always been to work somewhere in an area between fashion and publishing.
sentences.zh: 我一直梦想着从事一份介于时尚与出版之间的工作。

segments.text: My dream has always been to work somewhere in an area between fashion and publishing.

sentences.en: Two years before graduating from secondary school, I took a sewing and design course thinking that I would move on to a fashion design course.
sentences.zh: 中学毕业前两年，我参加了一门缝纫与设计课程，当时想着以后继续学习服装设计。

segments.text: Two years before graduating from secondary school, I took a sewing and design course thinking that I would move on to a fashion design course.

sentences.en: However, during that course I realized I was not good enough in this area to compete with other creative personalities in the future, so I decided that it was not the right path for me.
sentences.zh: 然而，在学习那门课程期间，我意识到自己在这一领域还不够出色，未来很难与其他富有创造力的人竞争，因此我认定这条路并不适合自己。

segments.text: However, during that course I realized I was not good enough in this area to compete with other creative personalities in the future, so I decided that it was not the right path for me.

sentences.en: Before applying for university I told everyone that I would study journalism, because writing was, and still is, one of my favourite activities.
sentences.zh: 申请大学之前，我告诉所有人自己要学新闻，因为写作当时是、现在也仍然是我最喜欢做的事情之一。

segments.text: Before applying for university I told everyone that I would study journalism, because writing was, and still is, one of my favourite activities.

sentences.en: But, to be honest, I said it, because I thought that fashion and me together was just a dream - I knew that no one could imagine me in the fashion industry at all!
sentences.zh: 但说实话，我之所以这样说，是因为我觉得自己与时尚结合在一起只不过是个梦想——我知道根本没人能想象我会进入时尚行业！

segments.text: But, to be honest, I said it, because I thought that fashion and me together was just a dream - I knew that no one could imagine me in the fashion industry at all!

sentences.en: So I decided to look for some fashion-related courses that included writing.
sentences.zh: 于是，我决定寻找一些既与时尚相关、又包含写作内容的课程。

segments.text: So I decided to look for some fashion-related courses that included writing.

sentences.en: This is when I noticed the course "Fashion Media & Promotion."
sentences.zh: 就在这时，我注意到了“时尚媒体与推广”这门课程。

segments.text: This is when I noticed the course "Fashion Media & Promotion."
